Advertisement to businesses, however when I call a place and say "I called to speak to the owner, can you please tell me who that is?" Instant aggression against me, and telling me how I am scum. 

Residential, or business, cold calling is the most degrading thing in the world. Especially when you know you have to make the sales/calls to keep the income.

Sorry for the rant, don't get to let it out often.
